mapper.select: SELECT * FROM EVALUATION_TYPE_WEIGHT ORDER BY eval_type
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO EVALUATION_TYPE_WEIGHT AS target USING (SELECT #{evalType} AS eval_type, #{weight} AS weight) AS source ON target.eval_type = source.eval_type WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET weight = source.weight WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (eval_type, weight) VALUES (source.eval_type, source.weight);
